name: kural
description: The company's only mouth, on Google ADK. A Claude-via-Vertex Envoy Lead qualifies an approved campaign; two Gemini scouts research audience and timing in parallel; a Gemini writer drafts founder-voice outreach grounded in the manas Context Pack; a Claude-via-Vertex Claim-Judge fact-checks every claim at a numeric gate (claim_support >= 0.80) and loops the draft back to be re-grounded until it verifies or rolls back; the run HALTS at the founder's publish sign-off before anything reaches the world. kural holds the channel keys, sends as the buyer behind an eligibility/value-cap gate and a no-double-send ledger, and never edits the creative. kural ENGAGES.

skills.name: Launch a campaign
skills.description: Take an approved decision + kalai's compliance-cleared master, qualify the engagement, research audience and timing in parallel, write founder-voice outreach grounded in the manas Context Pack, fact-check every claim at the claim_support >= 0.80 gate, and HALT at the founder's publish sign-off. Accepts and holds the campaign at the gate; the founder's tap-2 puts it live. Sends as the buyer behind an eligibility/value-cap gate and a no-double-send ledger. No creative is edited; nothing is published without the gate.
examples: Announce: Raise Pro to $34, grandfather existing subscribers, 30-day notice.
Announce the new annual Pro plan.

notes: Served manually by the FastAPI server rather than via ADK's to_a2a() helper: to_a2a() is currently blocked by the a2a-sdk 1.1.0 restructure (a2a.server.apps was moved, breaking the import path ADK expects). Until ADK pins/adapts to the new a2a-sdk layout, the server reads this static AgentCard and exposes it on the well-known discovery path itself, and answers JSON-RPC manually. Path is a2a-sdk-version-sensitive: recent A2A spec uses /.well-known/agent-card.json, older drafts used /.well-known/agent.json — confirm against the targeted a2a-sdk version when wiring the route. kural's second world-facing act (publish) is intentionally NOT exposed as an unguarded skill: it fires only after the founder's tap-2, dry-run by default.
